notes.title: The end of UGC Support
notes.notes:
[b]Lords![/b]

Dark times have fallen upon our realm.

With heavy hearts, we must inform you that[b] custom stories are no longer available[/b]. This unfortunate change comes as a result of [b]Unity discontinuing support for their User Generated Content (UGC) service[/b], which was used to bring your amazing stories to life in our beloved game. We will dearly miss your creativity…

[b]FAQ[/b]

[b]Is the Dark Lord in danger?![/b]
Fear not — the Dark Lord and his council are safe. The main campaign remains fully playable. This change only affects custom stories content.

[b]What will happen to my stories?[/b]
As of May 11, 2025, all user-generated stories were permanently deleted due to Unity’s legal and privacy obligations.

[b]What if I purchased DLCs?[/b]
You can request a refund in accordance with Steam’s general refund policy.

[b]How are you guys doing?[/b]
Honestly… we’re heartbroken. Your stories brought us joy, drama, and magic. It was an incredible chapter, and we’ll cherish it forever ❤️

notes.title: The Story Contest Results!
notes.notes:
Hey Dark Lords!

What a joy it was to dive into your stories! Your talent and sharp wit are truly beyond comparison, which made it almost impossible to choose winners without going mad! Or maybe we did after all? Nevertheless, here are the winners:

[b]1st place and $1000[/b] – Purrfect Reincarnation by Gorgonage

[i]“Once, four heroes defeated the Dark Lord. Only one loyal servant remained, determined to revive his master… but something went terribly wrong when a cat entered the summoning circle.”[/i]

We simply couldn't resist rewarding this captivating story that spans a massive 7 chapters, featuring interesting characters and great use of the resource system. Be careful, you can actually lose if you're not attentive enough.

[b]2nd place and $500[/b] – The Calamity Egg by Azz-Rushman

[i]“During your successful campaign surrendering humans and the species fighting on their side, news of an ultimate weapon quickly arise all around the continent. The legend says that the enormous creature born from the Calamity Egg would harbor a power capable of dominating the entire world, and that it would only obey the orders of the first figure it sees upon birth.”[/i]

This dramatic story intrigued us with its premise and surprised us with its moral choices. The ending you get depends entirely on you!

[b]3rd place and $250[/b] – Bum’sekai by tarax

[i]“An isekai story with you as the average Bum”[/i]

It might sound almost like a joke, but this story, filled with interesting world-building and brutal lore elements, will keep you hooked. It's up to you to decide what happens with the world you find yourself in.

While we congratulate our winners, the celebration isn't over! We want to express our gratitude and appreciation for all the submitted works and reward other participants with the "Say thank you to developers" DLC. However, this time, it's us saying thank you!

To all participants, please contact [url=https://steamcommunity.com/profiles/76561199474884064]our representative on Steam[/url] to receive your prizes. Thank you again for your participation and your creative stories!

notes.title: The Story Contest Returns!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey Dark Lords – old-timers and newcomers![/b]

The long-awaited Dark Lord release took place yesterday, and we’re here now to announce a community contest! The story writing competition is an ancient tradition of this community, and it's time to bring it back! To be a successful Dark Lord, one needs to be creative, so show off your best works and etch your name into the history of our game!

[b]How to join:[/b]
[list]
[*] Settle into your throne, delve into the depths of your imagination, and bring your ideas to life. Before you begin, ensure you know the competition's rules and guidelines below.
[*] Submit your masterpieces via our very cool and handy in-game Community Stories mode editor [b]no later than September 1st[/b].
[*] Don’t forget to add [Contest] to the title of your story (you can change it after the contest ends).
[*] Once submitted, take pride in your work, read other creators’ stories, and wait for September 6th, the day that we announce the results!
[/list][b]Prizes galore[/b]

Your story can span any genre—dramatic, comedic, mystical, or even meme-inspired. The authors of the best tales will be rewarded handsomely:
[list]
[*] 1st Place: $1000
[*] 2nd Place: $500
[*] 3rd Place: $250
[/list][i]Note: the prizes are distributed via Amazon or Steam gift cards (read the contest’s Terms and Conditions for more details).[/i]

[b]Competition guidelines[/b]

[list]
[*] Watch our demo [url=https://youtu.be/xeok2_AOV38]guide for creating stories[/url].
[*] Entries must have a minimum of 30 cards and 15 steps (if you follow the shortest path), each with a situation description and two choice options. Don't forget to choose an avatar for each card, and also choose a picture.
[*] Each participant may submit up to 3 stories, but can only win once.
[*] Only original works made specifically for this contest are eligible.
[*] By entering, you agree that if your story wins, it may be used for marketing, advertising, or other related purposes.
[*] Full terms and conditions are available on our [url=https://discord.com/channels/1070492222140727318/1197567596686475374]Discord server[/url].
[/list]
Good luck, and may inspiration flow abundantly!

notes.title: Dark Lord is released and more surprises are inside!
notes.notes:
Greetings, Dark Lords!

The moment we've all been waiting for has finally arrived—you can now dive into the mysterious story of the Dark Lord absolutely FREE! We want to thank everyone who played our demo and for their support and feedback, without you, the final game wouldn't be what it is today!

[previewyoutube=RAAQf1DI7Lk;full][/previewyoutube]

Step into the treacherous yet enticing shoes of the Dark Lord as you navigate a realm filled with eccentric characters and intricate plots. Expand your dark influence across new lands, and master the delicate balance between political intrigue and military might. Manage advisors who are as likely to stab you in the back as they would kneel before you in awe.

As you fortify your stronghold, you'll also dive into a narrative that continuously unfolds and is layered with deliciously dark humor. The cherry on top is the special [b]Community Stories Mode[/b]. In this mode, you can explore the tales crafted by other players, as well as create and share your adventures using our editor.

But that's not all! What’s a great game without DLCs? We have three available now, with more on the way!
[list]
[*] [b]Disenchanting Ritual DLC[/b]: An exclusive story about the Cat—your oddly intelligent furry companion - and yes, you read that correctly! Is there more to this pet than meets the eye? Put your trust in the Dark Wizard, perform the disenchantment ritual, and reveal the true nature of the Cat. What secrets will be uncovered, and where will this whimsical journey lead? It's time to find out!
[*] [b]Forbidden Magic DLC[/b]: Link your Steam account with the LTG Platform to access a unique story about your loyal magical advisor! In this two-episode tale, you will have to help the Dark Wizard uncover the secrets of the forbidden arts and achieve the ultimate mastery of magic. This adventure will be one of the most dangerous you'll face because, as you know, forbidden magic is no laughing matter! 
[*] [b]Supporter Pack[/b]: A pack where you can show your gratitude to the developers! This pack includes additional visual content that will enhance your gaming experience, allowing you to enjoy new appearances for your cards, fresh visual effects, and other unique elements that make your journey much more special!
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/1443c71fcac8494d98601db3673d310d160c27b2.png[/img]
Good luck with your adventures in the dark realms! Don’t forget to share your thoughts on the final game and join our [url=https://discord.gg/DT68NpcwJm]community[/url] to stay updated on the latest news!

notes.title: Story Contest Results!
notes.notes:
Hey Dark Lords!

After much anticipation, we've completed our dive into your incredible submissions. It's clear you all poured your hearts into this, making our choice a challenging one! With over 35 unique tales submitted, we navigated through 1,800+ narrative cards, saw over 90 endings, and fell for our characters all over again. We evaluated these tales based on their content, intrigue, length, nonlinearity, and the diversity of endings—true to the spirit of Dark Lord, where every choice matters. But, as with any contest not held in a kindergarten, winners must be crowned. So, without further ado, here are our champions:

[b]1st place and $1000[/b] goes to [b][i]Drunk Lord[/i][/b] by @Lach_2110

With a staggering 256 passages, Drunk Lord takes first place for its sheer scope, engaging plot, multiple endings, and brilliant humor. 

[i]“Welcome to Drunk Lord! Face your greatest foe: your drunken self. The Dark Lord wakes after a wild night on the town, having misplaced the legendary sword, Lordsbane. In the wrong hands, it could spell the end of your kingdom. Getting it back is your utmost priority. Or is it? Navigate this text-based adventure however you desire. It's Dark Lord meets The Hangover, with a dash of Morrowind. Choose your path or shirk your responsibilities. Uncover the mystery. With six possible endings and numerous game-play choices, Drunk Lord rewards curiosity and is designed to be played more than once.”[/i]

[b]2nd place and $750[/b] goes to [b][i]The Sealed City[/i][/b] by @giyuga

Naturally, the community story mode embraces both the light-hearted and the profound. This is why we were captivated by a story that unveils a new and enigmatic realm within the Dark Lord universe.

[i]“You’ve been awoken in the dead of night by an earthquake! Turns out it have broken not only your slumber but also the nearby mountain. With this came miraculous news — there was a city under this mountain all along. Are there still people there? Are they friends or foes? There is only one way to find out!
This epic non-linear adventure has several endings, battles, magic, mystery and a lot of danger for a reckless Dark Lord. Will you perish? Or will you uncover the mystery of The Sealed City?”[/i]

[b]3rd place and $500[/b] goes to [b][i]The Cat Lord[/i][/b] by @yarseit

Capturing our affection for felines—which many of you noticed—The Cat Lord emerged as the top "cat" narrative. 

[i]“What? Someone turned the Dark Lord into a cat? What kind of impudence is this? You need to figure it out.”[/i]

But that's not all! The sheer volume and quality of submissions deserve special recognition. So, we're awarding a [b]$50 People's Choice Award[/b] to these remarkable stories:

[list]
[*] [b][i]Catocalypse[/i][/b] by @alastor9000
[*] [b][i]My pal—the Paladin[/i][/b] by @anna19952558
[*] [b][i]The Bone Dragon[/i][/b] by @keldalas
[*] [b][i]Meteorite and witch[/i][/b] by @vdm_blgkv
[*] [b][i]The Secret Expedition[/i][/b] by @nikiprotiv
[*] [b][i]The Labyrinth of Love[/i][/b] by Ekaterina Golub
[*] [b][i]Dark Lord Story[/i][/b] by Michael Sychov
[*] [b][i]Traitorous Knight[/i][/b] by @shamesash
[/list]

We'd love to sing praises for each submission, as they've truly moved us and deserve every bit of acclaim. However, the Internet might just run out of space if we tried! Instead, keep an eye out for the upcoming story editor release—soon, you'll have the chance to showcase your masterpiece to the world. The wait is almost over! (wink-wink)

We'll reach out to [u]all winners[/u] to arrange prize distribution (please check your Discord privacy settings). These stories are being translated and will soon be added to the game for everyone to enjoy. Thank you for your participation, and we look forward to seeing your creativity in future contests!

Surely, we couldn’t arrive at the festival empty-handed. Here’s the list of changes we implemented for the game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44742537/66948aa7da3c0c08399191641df2418067f73f25.jpg[/img]

notes.title: The Legendary Stories Contest Begins!
notes.notes:
Listen up, Dark Lords!

Lay down your sword and arm yourself with the mightiest weapon of all—your brilliantly twisted mind. The story-writing competition has started! You’re in for not just cash prizes, but also fame, honor, and a chance to etch your name in history (or at least in our game).

[b]How to join the fray?[/b]
[list][*]Settle into your throne, delve into the depths of your imagination, and bring your ideas to life. Before you begin, ensure you're familiar with the competition's rules and guidelines detailed below.
[*]Submit your masterpieces [u]in .twee format[/u] together with the name of your work, its short description (up to 600 characters) and your Discord tag to community@longtalegames.com with the subject ‘Dark Lord Contest’ [b]before February 11[/b].
[*]Once submitted, take pride in your work and await the results.
[/list]
[b]Prizes galore[/b]

Your stories can span any genre—dramatic, comedic, mystical, or even meme-inspired. The authors of the best tales will be rewarded handsomely:

1st Place: $1000
2nd Place: $750
3rd Place: $500

[u]Bonus:[/u] Your story featured in the game for all to see!

[i]Additionally,[/i] special $50 cash incentives are up for grabs to ensure no hidden gem goes unnoticed.

[b]Competition guidelines[/b]
[list][*]Submissions are accepted exclusively via community@longtalegames.com 
[*]Format: Diagrams in Twine. Requirements for the format of the work and instructions for preparation can be found [url=https://doc.clickup.com/9004026212/p/h/8cax2b4-6668/dd46e220ca291ba/8cax2b4-6668]here[/url].
[*]And here is a [url=https://youtu.be/VcTYGVEOrfI]quick guide[/url] to converting your idea into a game story.
[*]Entries must have a minimum of 30 cards and 15 steps along the shortest path, each with a situation description and two choice options. Don't forget to choose an avatar for each card and choose a picture.
[*]Each participant may submit up to 5 stories, but only one can claim a prize.
[*]Only original works crafted specifically for this contest are eligible.
[*]By entering, you agree that if your story wins, it may be used for marketing, advertising, or other related purposes.
[*]Full terms and conditions are available on [url=https://discord.com/channels/1070492222140727318/1197567596686475374]our Discord[/url].[/list]
Good luck, and may inspiration flow abundantly!
